prompt: A fire station with firefighters and equipment. A firefighter is polishing a fire truck while wearing protective gear. Another firefighter is testing a hose by spraying water into a drain. The hose is coiled on a reel mounted on the truck. A fire chief is inspecting equipment while holding a checklist and pointing at an oxygen tank. The oxygen tank is positioned next to a ladder. The fire chief, with more experience, appears older than the firefighter polishing the truck. In the equipment room, shelves hold five boots and a number of helmets. The number of helmets is one less than the number of boots. A dalmatian dog is sitting beside the fire truck, wearing a collar with a badge. An alarm bell is mounted on the wall above the garage doors. A rookie firefighter is practicing with a rope while standing on a mat. On a nearby wall, a rack holds a number of firefighter jackets, equal to the number of firefighters mentioned in the scene.
